lines.en: Today I am presenting the song “Radioactive” by Imagine Dragons.
I chose this song because I like the music video.
It is strange, exciting, and very different from other music videos.
My favorite part is the fight with the small pink teddy bear.
First, look at the teddy bear.
It is small, pink, and looks cute and weak.
The other fighter is much bigger and looks very strong.
We think the teddy bear is going to lose.
But then it gets up again and wins the fight.
I think the teddy bear shows that someone can look weak but still be very strong.
The mood of the video is strange, exciting, and powerful.
The message is about finding your strength and fighting back.
At first, the teddy bear looks weak and has no chance.
But it does not give up.
It gets back up and defeats the much bigger fighter.
“Even if people think you are weak, you can still be strong.”
That is why I think “Radioactive” has a powerful and interesting music video.
